claim: Moosbauer et al. (TEVC 2022) formalize a generic multi-fidelity HPO algorithm whose design space includes both a surrogate-learner axis (RF, KNN1, KKNN7, TPE-density) and a sampling/search-strategy axis, structurally paralleling offline MBO's surrogate x optimizer factorial -- but transplanted to HPO-algorithm design, not offline black-box optimization.
stance_target: N6 crossed surrogate-class x optimizer factorial novelty
scope_conditions: Multi-fidelity hyperparameter optimization (MF-HPO), YAHPO Gym benchmarks
quoted_support: We try several surrogate learners: Random forests (RF), K-nearest-neighbors with k set to 1 (KNN1), kernelized K-nearest-neighbors with ‘optimal’ weighting (KKNN7), and the ratio of density predictions of good and bad points, similar to tree parzen estimators (TPE) without a hierarchical structure as done in BOHB.

claim: The paper explicitly names ANOVA and functional ANOVA as known sensitivity-analysis methods in its background section, then deliberately chooses one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) ablation instead for cost reasons, and states OFAT cannot detect interactions between inputs.
stance_target: N6 NONE FOUND (no two-way ANOVA/eta^2 crossed factorial)
scope_conditions: Section 5.2, Algorithm Analysis / sensitivity analysis background
quoted_support: We want to limit the costs of performing such a sensitivity analysis, either by approximating the mathematical model to be investigated by a surrogate, or by choosing a method that keeps the resource requirements of the experimental design reasonably low, like for example a one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) analysis. Those methods have their own limitations; for example, any interactions between inputs cannot be detected by an OFAT analysis.

claim: RQ6 tests the effect of different surrogate models on final HPO performance by swapping one inducer at a time into an already-optimized configuration, not via a full factorial grid.
quoted_support: RQ6 – Effect of surrogate models: We evaluate the overall result γ*[equal] with I_fsur set to each of the inducers in the original search space (see Tbl. 4). Furthermore, γ*[equal] is evaluated with ρ set to 1 (all points are randomly sampled, independent of the filtering model), and finally, with ρ=1 and Pλ(A)=uniform (all points are sampled completely model-free).

claim: The paper's surrogate axis is the meta-surrogate inside an HPO optimizer targeting ML-model hyperparameters, a different application layer than offline MBO's target-model surrogate class.
scope_conditions: Whole paper -- MF-HPO applied to lcbench, AutoML pipeline configuration, NAS via YAHPO Gym
quoted_support: We present a principled approach to automated benchmark-driven algorithm design applied to multifidelity HPO (MF-HPO).
